verdict.rationale: Bolt supports exporting/syncing generated code to GitHub (bolt-docs-2, bolt-docs-4, bolt-docs-30, bolt-docs-31), which lets a developer take the code out and deploy it on their own infrastructure or another host, and a user report confirms real-world deployment to Vercel/Netlify outside Bolt's own hosting flow (bolt-comm-8). However, Bolt's own documented deploy path is really its own hosting/custom-domain feature (bolt-docs-12, bolt-docs-13, bolt-docs-16), not a first-class 'deploy elsewhere' workflow, and the community report shows friction/breakage when mixing Bolt's own deploy with an external host (ghost files, broken payment calls). Missing for 10: a documented first-party 'export and deploy to arbitrary host/cloud provider' feature or CLI, and independent confirmation that such external deploys work reliably without Bolt-side conflicts.
